Cost first (finance): Confirm with a fluid sample, then adjust choke / gas-lift to the new operating point.
Production first (production manager): Confirm with a fluid sample, then adjust choke / gas-lift to the new operating point.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Confirm with a fluid sample, then adjust choke / gas-lift to the new operating point.

Cost first (finance): Watch closely and make a small choke adjustment to restore stable flow.
Production first (production manager): Watch closely and make a small choke adjustment to restore stable flow.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Watch closely and make a small choke adjustment to restore stable flow.

Cost first (finance): Increase hydrate-inhibitor dosing while the line still flows.
Production first (production manager): Increase hydrate-inhibitor dosing while the line still flows.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Increase hydrate-inhibitor dosing while the line still flows.

Cost first (finance): Stop gas lift through the blocked line and produce without it meanwhile.
Production first (production manager): Depressurize the service line from both sides and inject inhibitor.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Stop gas lift through the blocked line and produce without it meanwhile.

Cost first (finance): Check the production choke and restore it to its set-point.
Production first (production manager): Check the production choke and restore it to its set-point.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Check the production choke and restore it to its set-point.

Cost first (finance): Change the operating point (open choke / increase gas lift) to keep natural flow.
Production first (production manager): Change the operating point (open choke / increase gas lift) to keep natural flow.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Run a well test and update the reservoir model.

Cost first (finance): Open the choke further to compensate.
Production first (production manager): Open the choke further to compensate.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Inject scale inhibitor upstream of the choke.

Cost first (finance): Choke back the production choke to stabilise the flow.
Production first (production manager): Switch on active (feedback) slug control on the production choke.
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Switch on active (feedback) slug control on the production choke.

Cost first (finance): Equalize pressure across the DHSV, then reopen it through its hydraulic control line (corrective operating procedure).
Production first (production manager): Equalize pressure across the DHSV, then reopen it through its hydraulic control line (corrective operating procedure).
Safety first (HSE, well integrity): Equalize pressure across the DHSV, then reopen it through its hydraulic control line (corrective operating procedure).
